items.title: DeepMind CEO calls for an independent standards body to regulate frontier AI
items.description: DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis is proposing an AI "standards body" modeled after FINRA, to test frontier models and develop best practices for their release.
items.tldr: DeepMindのCEO、デミス・ハサビスは、フロンティアAIを規制するための独立した「スタンダードボディ」の設立を提案しており、FINRAをモデルにしてフロンティアモデルのテストと最良の実践を策定することを目指しています。

items.title: Meta accused of using biased AI targeting for mass layoffs
items.description: A group of 26 former Meta employees is suing the company over claims that it used AI tools to unfairly target workers on leave with layoffs, as reported earlier by Reuters. In the lawsuit, the employees allege Meta determined which workers to dismiss based on performance data collected by a "constel
items.tldr: MetaがAIツールを使用して休職中の従業員を不公平に解雇対象にしたとして、26人の元従業員が訴訟を起こした。

items.title: How I’m Making Sure My Analytics Career Doesn’t Get Eaten by AI
items.description: The analytics career I signed up for five years ago doesn't exist anymore, and honestly, I am fine with that. The post How I’m Making Sure My Analytics Career Doesn’t Get Eaten by AI appeared first on Towards Data Science.
items.tldr: AIの進化により、5年前に始めたアナリティクスのキャリアは変化しており、著者はその変化を受け入れつつ、自身のキャリアを守るための戦略を模索している。

items.title: Meta’s Adam Mosseri says AI token budgets could soon be capped per engineer
items.description: Instagram head Adam Mosseri believes companies will eventually need to manage AI token spending the same way they manage payroll or other operating expenses, predicting that engineers could soon face limits on how much they spend using AI tools.
items.tldr: Metaのアダム・モッセリ氏は、企業がAIトークンの支出を給与やその他の運営費用と同様に管理する必要があり、エンジニアがAIツールの使用に制限を受ける可能性があると予測しています。

items.title: Celebrating 25 years of visual search innovation
items.description: Google Images is turning 25. Here’s a look back at some major milestones — and new ways to explore and create visual content.
items.tldr: Google Imagesが25周年を迎え、視覚検索の革新における重要なマイルストーンと新しい視覚コンテンツの探索・作成方法が紹介されています。

items.title: The Google Images homepage will recommend photos even before you search
items.description: Google is announcing a big change to the Google Images homepage in honor of the platform's 25th anniversary this week. items.title: Google Images gets a Pinterest-like redesign focused on discovery
items.description: Now, when users navigate to Google Images, they'll see a "For You" gallery of images tailored to their interests and browsing history.
items.tldr: TL;DR: Google ImagesがPinterestのようなデザインにリニューアルされ、ユーザーの興味や閲覧履歴に基づいた「For You」ギャラリーが表示されるようになった。

items.title: Spotify is now an AI chatbot, too
items.description: Spotify is experimenting with a new AI feature that allows Premium subscribers to play and explore music, audiobooks, and podcasts by having conversations with a chatbot. items.title: New York State halts construction of all new data centers
items.description: New York has become the first state to temporarily halt approval of large data centers, as Gov. Kathy Hochul argues the AI-driven building boom shouldn’t come at the expense of higher electricity costs, water supplies, or local control.
items.tldr: ニューヨーク州は、大規模データセンターの新規建設の承認を一時停止し、AI主導の建設ブームが電気料金や水資源、地域の管理に悪影響を及ぼすべきではないと州知事のキャシー・ホクルが主張しています。

items.title: Reflection inks $1B compute deal with Nebius
items.description: Reflection AI has signed a $1 billion deal to access Nebius' compute. Reflection was founded in 2024 and is developing open source AI technology.

items.title: The real AI race may no longer be at the frontier
items.description: Hugging Face CEO Clem Delangue says enterprises increasingly want open models, due to cost, accessibility, and ownership. Do frontier models still matter if most production AI ends up running on open models?
items.tldr: TL;DR: Hugging FaceのCEOクレム・デランゲは、企業がコストやアクセス性、所有権の理由からオープンモデルを求める傾向が強まっていると述べ、ほとんどの生産AIがオープンモデルで運用される場合、フロンティアモデルの重要性が薄れる可能性があると指摘しています。

items.title: Spotify expands its AI push with a ChatGPT-like music assistant
items.description: Spotify is rolling out a new AI-powered conversational feature that lets Premium subscribers chat with the app to discover music, podcasts, audiobooks, and more.

items.title: Sam Altman didn’t need another lawsuit

items.title: Superhuman’s new auto-draft feature almost makes me like AI replies

items.title: How Much Does It Actually Cost to Run a Local LLM? (Euros per Million Tokens, Measured)

items.title: How to manage AI investments in the agentic era

items.title: Microsoft starts testing cleaner Windows Search without ads
items.description: Microsoft is now testing a cleaner and faster version of Windows Search that should prioritize relevant results over ads and promotional content. [...]
items.tldr: Microsoftは、広告やプロモーションコンテンツを排除し、関連性の高い結果を優先するクリーンで高速なWindows Searchのテストを開始しました。
